title: Classic Chicago Cartoonists, 1931
content: Here's a little video with glimpses of the cartoonists of Chicago in 1931, who worked under the same roof in the Tribune building.(Link to video)The video, which was a promotional film for the Chicago Tribune newspaper, gives the sense of the impact the funnies (and newspapers generally) had on people during the Depression.A few of the artists are filmed drawing their characters, such as Andy Gump, Little Orphan Annie, and Gasoline Alley. Walt Disney appears with them as just one of the cartoonist guys, even though he didn't do the cartoons (Floyd Gottfredsondid).Many of those cartoons appear in the gang page above, fromMel Birnkrant's collection.-----Link to YouTubeClassic Chicago Tribune Cartoonists - 1931Mel Birnkrant's webpage with the cartoon art
